kept_breakthroughs.plain_title: FP8 + N-Gram Spec + Sparse MoE Tile Schedule
kept_breakthroughs.hypothesis: Tuning Triton fused_moe tile sizes (BLOCK_SIZE_M=16/32) for sparse E=128 expert routing on Blackwell SM12.0 alongside FP8 weights and GPU N-Gram speculation eliminates zero-padding waste in the dominant fused_moe_kernel (46.5% GPU time).

Pinning BLOCK_SIZE_N=64 (exact divisor of moe_intermediate_size=704=11*64) and BLOCK_SIZE_M=16 up to M=256 (matching M*8/128=16 tokens/expert) while tightening ngram_gpu to min=3, tokens=2 cuts 2D tile padding and speculative MoE bloat.

Adding --kv-cache-dtype=fp8 halves KV cache bandwidth in kernel_unified_attention (12.3% GPU time), while setting num_stages=3 and GROUP_SIZE_M=8 in moe_tuned_config improves L2 activation reuse and SM120 CTA occupancy for fused_moe_kernel (45.4% GPU time).
